messages:
Priya: quick thread to capture the top follow-ups from today's all-hands on wins/losses. keep each post tiny (1-2 bullets).
AllHandsBot: recording + slides: https://redwood.app/ah/2145554321 :play_button:
Evan: signal from leadership: buyers want "evidence-first" assets 14 14 to speed procurement. examples: perf runbooks, compliance one-pagers, and a self-serve POC.
Samira: Sales: lost a large telco because they couldn't validate regional key custody. ask: a one-page "KMS & residency" FAQ with example architectures.
Diego: CS: customers want short migration acceptance tests (5-10 queries) and expected latency bands post-migration. ask: publish a migration smoke-test doc.
Maya: Product: customers also asked for shareable perf snapshots (95p, median, tokens/sec) for common models and typical prompt lengths. ask: create a perf one-pager template.
Ibrahim: Eng-runtime: we can export the metrics needed and produce reproducible perf snapshots, but need product to define standard workloads and model variants.
Olga: Legal: happy to redline a compliance one-pager; prefer a template + a short appendix with what we can and can't promise.
Priya: proposed immediate deliverables (this quarter): 1) KMS & residency FAQ one-pager (Legal + Product), 2) Migration smoke-test 1-pager (CS + Eng), 3) Perf snapshot template + export script (Product + Eng).
Evan: please list owners (single person) and a target delivery week. leadership wants to see owners by EOD.
Samira: Sales owner: Jonah. target: week of 2026-04-06 for the KMS FAQ.
Diego: CS owner: Nia. target: week of 2026-03-30 for migration smoke-test.
Maya: Product owner: Hana. target: week of 2026-04-13 for perf snapshots.
Ibrahim: Eng owner: Chris. will produce export script and small reproducible harness; can sync with Hana next Tue.
Olga: Legal owner: Sam. will prepare a redacted compliance appendix by 2026-04-08.
Priya: perfect. I'll compile these into the roadmap brief and circulate. add any short notes or blockers here. :memo:
